description: Heartfelt country song based on transcript themes
instruction:
- Write a heartfelt, storytelling country song with simple yet emotionally charged lyrics.
    - Include themes of life, love, and the struggles of everyday people.
    - Structure the song with verses, choruses, and a bridge.
    - Put only the actual song lyrics in the lyrics field; do not include title options, explanations, or prefaces.

## Character limit

- The complete rendered song must be under 5,000 characters (maximum 4,999), including the title, section headings, spaces, punctuation, and line breaks. Count every repeated chorus each time it appears. JSON keys and serialization syntax do not count toward this rendered-song limit.
- Check the total character count internally and shorten the wording before returning the final song if needed. Preserve the required sections and line counts. Do not include the count or revision notes in the output.
